summary: BE Labor amount missing thousands separator in totals section
reported_issue: In the invoice totals block, the Labor amount rendered without a thousands separator when four digits or more (e.g. $1280.00 instead of $1,280.00).
expected_after_fix: Labor total should display as $1,280.00 with standard US number formatting; the same rule applied consistently to Parts, Shop supplies, Subtotal, Tax, and Total.
steps_i_followed: Located a work order whose Labor total exceeds $999 by scanning the totals block of several WOs
Opened WO S12-23530 (id 54b32f65...) Finance tab and read the totals block
Verified formatting of Labor and the other total rows
Also confirmed 4-5 digit amounts render with commas across the WO list and finance line items
actual_now: The totals block renders Labor = $1,215.00 with a thousands separator (four+ digit value correctly comma-formatted). The other rows are also correctly formatted: Subtotal $4,251.46, GST $212.57, Total $4,464.03, Balance $4,464.03. No '$1215.00'-style unformatted values were observed anywhere; every 4-5 digit currency amount across the WO list ($9,928.86, $34,983.03, $87,269.73) and finance also uses commas.
notes: Verified in the WO Finance totals block (the invoice totals section). Labor >= $1,000 now shows the thousands separator consistently with Subtotal/Tax/Total.
